q: [MCQ] Consider an array-based min-heap with elements [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]. The time complexity of building this heap using Floyd's algorithm is:
explanation: Floyd's algorithm (heapify) builds a heap by starting from non-leaf nodes and performing down-heaps. Time complexity is O(n) because the sum of heights of all non-leaf nodes is O(n).

explanation: After deleting 25, the left subtree of 50 becomes unbalanced. The AVL tree performs rotation to rebalance. Minimum rotations needed = 1 (single or double rotation).

q: [MCQ] Consider the following recurrence relation: T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n. Using Master theorem, T(n) is:
explanation: Master theorem: T(n) = aT(n/b) + f(n). Here a=2, b=2, f(n)=n. n^(log_b a) = n^1 = n. f(n) = n = Θ(n^1). Case 2: T(n) = Θ(n log n).

[MSQ] Which of the following about graph algorithms are CORRECT?

S1: Dijkstra's algorithm works for graphs with negative edge weights
S2: Bellman-Ford can detect negative cycles
S3: DFS can be used to detect cycles in undirected graphs
S4: BFS finds shortest path in unweighted graphs
explanation: S1 ✗ FALSE: Dijkstra requires non-negative weights. S2 ✓ TRUE: Bellman-Ford detects negative cycles. S3 ✓ TRUE: DFS can detect cycles via back edges. S4 ✓ TRUE: BFS finds shortest path in unweighted graphs.

q: [MCQ] The worst-case time complexity of Quicksort on an already sorted array of n elements is:
explanation: Quicksort has worst-case O(n²) when pivot selection is poor (e.g., always smallest/largest element). On sorted arrays with poor pivot selection, this occurs.

q: [MCQ] In a rope data structure (concatenation of strings), the time complexity of concatenating two ropes of length m and n is:
explanation: Rope is a tree structure. Concatenation is O(1) by simply creating a new node with left and right child pointers to the two rope roots.

[MSQ] Which statements about the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) problem are TRUE?

S1: LCS can be solved using dynamic programming
S2: LCS of two strings of length m and n requires O(mn) time
S3: LCS is same as Longest Common Substring
S4: LCS requires O(min(m,n)) space if we only need length
explanation: S1 ✓ TRUE: LCS uses DP. S2 ✓ TRUE: DP table is m×n. S3 ✗ FALSE: LCS is subsequence, not substring. S4 ✗ FALSE: Need O(mn) space for full DP table, or O(min(m,n)) space-optimized.

explanation: Segment tree for range query uses divide-and-conquer. For range [1,4] accessing indices 3,5,7,9: requires accessing nodes covering these ranges, typically 3-4 nodes in optimal traversal.

explanation: Median-of-medians algorithm guarantees O(n) linear time for finding k-th smallest element by ensuring good pivot selection in quickselect.
